programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 6
Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 2
Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 7
programme.desc: The first Chris Craft boat was built by Christopher Colombus Smith in 1874, and since the brand has left its mark on many. Now we have the chance to try the Capri 27, built with modern materials but the same care and precision as the old master carpenters. Then, we will discover Eleva Yachts in the Marina degli Aregai before getting onboard the Benetti 125 Rolls Royce Azipull. Come join us!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 8
programme.desc: In today's episode of The Boat Show we get on board a really special superyacht. Built by Benetti and propulsed by Rolls Royce we are on board the Benetti 125 Fast. Then, we get on board the Azimut S6 to remember the sport factor in a luxury yacht. Come join us on board!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10 - Losinj – Istria
programme.desc: We have arrived at the beautiful islands of Cres and Lošinj where we will explore amazing places and learn how to cook buzara (Buzara is Croatian way of cooking mussels with only few simple ingredients. This easy mussels recipe is popular along the Dalmatian coast). We will also sail over to Istria and the magical islands of Brijuni.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1 - Dubrovnik – Lastovo
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. Breathtaking landscapes, untouched nature, exquisite cuisine, no wonder Croatia is by many considered to be a true Hedonist Paradise.) We start at the southernmost part of the Croatian Coast - the old city of Dubrovnik. We will reveal you some secrets and show you some interesting attractions. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 3 - GP France Macon
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Binh Dinh (Vietnam Ski)
International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 4 World Cup Markkleeberg
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 1 - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. Wild Surf - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Surf, we’re in the Mentawai islands in Indonesia for ‘Morning Glory’, a documentary featuring eight French surfers as they head to the islands in search of the perfect surf. Featuring surfers Marc Lacomare, Benjamin Sanchis, Alain Riou, Naum Ildefonse, Romain Cloitre, Jason Aparicio and Charly Martin, Morning Glory takes us on a journey through some of the best waves in the islands. From the infamous Greenbush to the little known Roxy, this is the surfing trip of a lifetime.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 4
programme.desc: A packed episode for you, with footage from the Nixon Surf Challenge, the story of MS surfboards and ‘Away’ - an amazing short documentary about three women who surf in New York City. The Nixon surf challenge has been going on for a decade now. The event has grown from a casual get together of befriended riders, into the annual trip it is today.

programme.title: Who is Vilayta
programme.desc: WHO IS VILAYTA reveals the nature of Vilayta, one of the pioneers of big wave surfing on the Canary Islands. This short biographical documentary shares with us his deep connection with the ocean and Germán Pinelo captures this perfectly in this impressive world.This short documentary is full of unrepeatable moments. Filled with people who love what they do, that do not stop dreaming and living life how they want to. Combining passions, dreams, friendship, craziness and sweetness, Who is Vilayta deepens the character beyond the figure of the surfer. An artful motion picture that breaks myth and makes legends.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.6 - NIN - PAG
The Barrel
programme.desc: Since the first wave was ridden, surfers have shared stories and experiences to try to explain the wonders inside the waves they ride.Professional and amateur surfers, photographers and videographers around the world have the possibility to display their passion: Barrel surfing. This term is used by surfers to describe riding well inside the curve of a finely shaped breaking wave, for many described as magical.The Barrel is all about surfer’s skills, creativity and love for adventure as they look for the best waves for tube riding. Get inside the barrel of the wave, with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 1 Alicante - HL
Wind Masters - Episode 8: Rab, Mali Lošinj, Cres
The Irish Gathering
programme.desc: The Nautical Channel team travels to Ireland to meet up with the Gathering Cruise at Kinsale. We will be discovering the sailing and culture of the West Coast as we meet up the gathering cruise, visit a classic boat regatta and sample some delicious Irish gourmet meals. However, the trip will take a turn as rough seas and strong wind turn their leisure cruise into a rescue operation. Will our crew be okay in the Irish cold waters? Let's find out in The Irish Gathering!

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to today's episode of Screen Heroes! We are in San Sebastian, not only one of Spain's most beautiful cities, but also home to one of the most important surfing festivals in the world. Then, we get transported to the African coastline with The African Project before returning to San Sebastian to discover what's inside the Teatro Principal.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi will discover the diverse marine ecosystem of Kilifi Creek. She will learn how to sail in three days in order to truly experience the creek. Andi goes 3 degrees south to meet Kevin, a local sailor who patiently teaches Andi the skills she needs in this short span of time. A true local experience is waiting if she can complete her training but failure is always lurking.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 3 - Freedom
programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 4 - Discovery
programme.desc: Deep into the empty desert of Mexico’s Baja Peninsula, the three are now in pursuit of a storm swell and predictions of surf. As the head towards what’s to be an iconic moment in the trip the stop off in Tortuga Bay and have a peculiar discovery of fossilized shark’s teeth deep in the heart of this cake yellow desert. Charging south on the heals of incoming surf they land in the midst of reach surf culture and smack in the middle of society. Now after over a month in isolation the three wrestle with the experience while chasing after the best waves of the trip.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2017
programme.desc: The Paris Boat Show is considered by the nautical industry one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public, this event is an absolute must, and we agree there is no other place like the Paris Nautic as France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the world. Thousands are expected to arrive on the 3rd of December until the following weekend, and fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles for the latest innovation and best deals. Are you going to miss it? Come join us, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode of Jump on Board, the girls and I will sail from Corfu to Paxos, the island created by Poseidon according to Greek mythology when he struck his trident on Corfu, breaking it in two. Let's hope that Linda, Cindy and Caitlin don't divide like the islands as they get to know each other better. Jump on board with us to find out!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1 - Dubrovnik – Lastovo
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race sails around 10 cities from all over the world, making it the ultimate test for sailors. The veterans finally get their memory back while for the rookies it feels like mission impossible. programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 3 - Freedom
programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 4 - Discovery
programme.desc: Deep into the empty desert of Mexico’s Baja Peninsula, the three are now in pursuit of a storm swell and predictions of surf. As the head towards what’s to be an iconic moment in the trip the stop off in Tortuga Bay and have a peculiar discovery of fossilized shark’s teeth deep in the heart of this cake yellow desert. Charging south on the heals of incoming surf they land in the midst of reach surf culture and smack in the middle of society. Now after over a month in isolation the three wrestle with the experience while chasing after the best waves of the trip.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.6 - NIN - PAG
Sylt - The Queen Of The North Sea
programme.desc: Welcome to Sylt! The northernmost island of Germany spreads for 40 kilometers and has been since ages a top nautical location. All year round you can find action here at the North Sea, and Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer is ready to disembark in this location and explore the queen of the North Sea with our team. She will meet the locals, get to know the hidden gems, the best places for surfing and sailing, discover the wildlife and explore the enormous PWA Grand Slam in Sylt – the windsurfing event to be! Get ready to dive into Sylt's secrets as we wander around an UNESCO World Heritage Site and get splashed with the windsurf action. Let's get going to Sylt - The Queen of the North Sea!

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 3
programme.desc: It's a new year, so what kind of resolutions have the America's Cup athletes made? And what's the local hangover cure for too much Bermudan rum? Find out in episode 3 of Road to Bermuda! We take look at the the regatta of 2015, before celebrating the start of the New Year with the local cocktail: dark ‘n’ stormies. Finally, we make sure we start the year in a good mood with the happiest man on the island, Johnny Barnes.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2 - Korcula – Stari Grad
programme.desc: Korcula is often referred as a little Dubrovnik and we will show you why is that. We will taste some amazing cuisine and attend Moreska dance that is preserved from the Middle Ages and it is performed only here on island of Korcula. After Korcula we visit beautiful Stari Grad town on the island of Hvar and wonder it's amazing old streets.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3 - Vrboska - Split
programme.desc: Small city of Vrboska is a little piece of paradise for yachtsmen and Split is the biggest city in Dalmatia. We will show you where to go, what to see, and of course, some amazing food suggestions.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Barbados
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Barbados while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Barbados: an eastern Caribbean island with colonial buildings, botanical gardens and 17th century plantation houses. Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Barbados.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the sunny French Riviera for the 2016 Cannes Yachting Festival, a gathering in the name of luxury and excellence. In this year's edition, more than 200 models will be shown for the first time ever in the world. Let's find out the highlights of this incredible boat show.

programme.title: Dragon Boat Club Crews World Championship Ravenna
programme.desc: The IDBF Worlds are coming back to Italy with strength for the first time since 2002. More than 5000 sailors from 27 countries will gather in Ravenna to celebrate the ancient Chinese tradition of dragon boating. The stakes are higher than just winning: it's about proving that this sport can have a cultural impact around the world.

programme.title: Campeonato Europeo Clubs Kayak Polo - Arcos de la Frontera
International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 5 World Cup Final Prague
programme.desc: Welcome to Prague in the Czech Republic for the final of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. The five-race series culminates over the course of this weekend with double points up for grabs to determine who will be crowned the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup winner. 244 athletes will be racing this weekend from 36 countries on the course on the Vltava River. Let's dive into the action of this final event in Prague!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom World Championship La Seu d'Urgell
programme.desc: In this episode we are in La Seu D'Urgell, in the Spanish Pyrenees, for the 2019 International Canoe Slalom World Championships. We started off with athletes from 63 nations competing for the title. Now, 8 nations remain in this 10-boat final in La Seu d'Urgell. Discover the most breath-taking moments of the 2019 event in Spain!

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: Located just a few degrees south of the equator, Papua New Guinea is a tapestry of virgin rainforest, unique cultures and an expansive coastline. Pouring out of its ‘Nakanai Plateau’ is the Beriman River. Over 40km in length from source to sea, it drops more than 2,000m before reaching the Solomon Sea.The Beriman Gorge’s mysterious and towering canyon walls have never before been explored. Kayakers Ben Stookesberry, Chris Korbulic, Ben Marr and Pedro Oliva set out to conquer these previously unchartered whitewater rapids.This is one of kayaking’s most significant challenges and during the 13-day expedition, their skills and patience are pushed to their limits. They navigate twelve distinct gorges, numerous class-5 rapids, inescapable vertical walls, fluctuating water levels and dense jungle cover. All of these untamed natural obstacles stand in the way of the quartet’s successful first descent.

programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 4 - Discovery
programme.desc: Deep into the empty desert of Mexico’s Baja Peninsula, the three are now in pursuit of a storm swell and predictions of surf. As the head towards what’s to be an iconic moment in the trip the stop off in Tortuga Bay and have a peculiar discovery of fossilized shark’s teeth deep in the heart of this cake yellow desert. Charging south on the heals of incoming surf they land in the midst of reach surf culture and smack in the middle of society. Now after over a month in isolation the three wrestle with the experience while chasing after the best waves of the trip.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 8: Rab, Mali Lošinj, Cres
The Irish Gathering
programme.desc: The Nautical Channel team travels to Ireland to meet up with the Gathering Cruise at Kinsale. We will be discovering the sailing and culture of the West Coast as we meet up the gathering cruise, visit a classic boat regatta and sample some delicious Irish gourmet meals. However, the trip will take a turn as rough seas and strong wind turn their leisure cruise into a rescue operation. Will our crew be okay in the Irish cold waters? Let's find out in The Irish Gathering!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2 - Korcula – Stari Grad
programme.desc: Korcula is often referred as a little Dubrovnik and we will show you why is that. We will taste some amazing cuisine and attend Moreska dance that is preserved from the Middle Ages and it is performed only here on island of Korcula. programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3 - Vrboska - Split
programme.desc: Small city of Vrboska is a little piece of paradise for yachtsmen and Split is the biggest city in Dalmatia. We will show you where to go, what to see, and of course, some amazing food suggestions.

programme.title: VOR Supremacy
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race sails around 10 cities from all over the world, making it the ultimate test for sailors. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s big three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.The cannon blast in Alicante sends off the fleet, and once again shakes the sailing world. The veterans finally get their memory back while for the rookies it feels like mission impossible. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win it.The 2017-18 edition of the Volvo Ocean Race sets sail around the globe. The challenge is full on, and now they are all going rogue.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 4 - GP Italy Regione Sardegna - Olbia
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Italy (Ski Division)
Wild Surf - Episode 5
programme.desc: Starting the show we take a look at how the charity One Wave uses surfing and the power of the ocean to transform lives. Next, we take in more breath taking scenery from down under and uncover the surfing scene at some of the most notorious beaches in Australia.  Lastly, we check out some thrilling stand-up paddle surfing and follow the adventures of two brothers and surfing professionals, on their global search to discover the perfect wave.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 6
programme.desc: This week we’ve got a special episode featuring every surfers most feared predator – the shark. We’re speaking with our friends at the SeaLife London Aquarium, as well as pro surfers, Mick Fanning & Kelly Slater. We’ll be taking a look at the latest shark prevention technology, as well as the rescue teams who are keeping surfers safe from sharks. Plus, we’ve got a profile of Markus, a really talented shaper.

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.7 - NOVALJA - RAB
Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: XVIII Copa del Rey Vela Clásica - Episode 1 - Menorca
Inside Sailing - Episode 12
programme.desc: We start our last episode in 2019 in Muscar for the 5th and final even of the 2019 GC32 Racing Tour, the GC32 Oman Cup. Next, we will stay in a foiling mood and we will stay in Asia in order to follow the action at the 2019 Kitefoil World Series, in Weifang Binhai. Staying in Kiteboarding we will travel to Italy to take in the 2019 Formula Kite European Championships, hosted on the sandy beach of Oristano Gulf. Closing this trip around the world and closing our inside sailing journey for 2019 we will travel to Greece in order to dive into the beautiful Aegean Sea at the 23rd Rodos Cup, one of the most well-known cruising and racing events.

programme.desc: Coming up in this week's episode, the crews are ready for an all Australian adventure as they sail coast to coast. After seeing the New Year in Tasmania, this is the final race of this leg, and they will be racing to the breath-taking Whitsunday islands.

We started off with athletes from 63 nations competing for the title. Now, 8 nations remain in this 10-boat final in La Seu d'Urgell. Discover the most breath-taking moments of the 2019 event in Spain!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2 - Korcula – Stari Grad
programme.desc: Korcula is often referred as a little Dubrovnik and we will show you why is that. We will taste some amazing cuisine and attend Moreska dance that is preserved from the Middle Ages and it is performed only here on island of Korcula. After Korcula we visit beautiful Stari Grad town on the island of Hvar and wonder it's amazing old streets.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3 - Vrboska - Split
programme.desc: Small city of Vrboska is a little piece of paradise for yachtsmen and Split is the biggest city in Dalmatia. We will show you where to go, what to see, and of course, some amazing food suggestions.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 3
programme.desc: On this episode, we are going to check out the Surf at Lisbon Film Fest in Portugal. Lisbon has a lot more to offer than just world-class waves, and we are ready to dive into the film action. Come join us as we visit this important surfing festival and take a close look behind the scenes!

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 3
programme.desc: We venture into Kenya’s wild coastline in the Watamu region. This Marine reserve is incredibly unique and in order for Andi to truly experience it she has to learn to kite surf in a very short period of time. She needs help, so she decides to track down the Tribe Watersports and Ben Kelliher who will guide her through a crash course in kitesurfing. If she can do it in the allocated time, Ben has an incredible prize waiting for her.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 5 - Return
programme.desc: After nearly two months at sea, which now seems like lifetimes compounded by the suffering and challenge of the passage. The three are closing out their trip home and saving the best for last. Shocked by what seems to be death island, the three uncover shark hunters and in their last village before departure battle to resupply with the essentials of gas and water with the last pennies on the boat. Meanwhile the struggles of our filmmaker’s journey return along with the fear of going back to all that was left behind.

programme.title: Julbo Sail Session
programme.desc: The mythical, legendary Cape Horn towers high in the imagination of all sailors. Located in the southern part of the Patagonia, sailors will travel from Usuaïa to Cap Horn. Passing it is always a feat so you can imagine the adventure two men set out for themselves when they dreamed of being the ﬁrst to pass it in a Nacra.Aboard a flying catamaran, the Julbo Session is a unique event that requires constant attention. The situation at the Julbo Sail season is tense and things become serious as the sailors have to push forward whatever happens, as the weather window is very brief and they have little time to succeed in their adventure.Embark on this journey across la Tierra del Fuego, a mystical place with extraordinary landscapes and incredible shifts in weather that allowed sailors in the Nacra to achieve a lifetime dream: pass Cape Horn aboard a flying catamaran.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2018
programme.desc: The Nautic Paris International Boat Show returns in 2018 to welcome hundreds of nautical enthusiasts inside its doors. We will be able to find out the latest trends in nautical equipment, sailing vessels, superyachts or rental services. Are you ready to discover the latest in the nautical industry? Come dive with us in the 2018 Salon Nautique Paris.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this new episode of Jump on Board, Cindy, Linda and Caitlin sail from Paxos to Lefkada, the island of the ladies where Aphrodite was born and the Greek poet Sappho jumped from the cliffs to her death. Either the ladies will find love or misfortune this time, so let's find out on Jump on Board!

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.7 - NOVALJA - RAB
The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl - Ios
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl is in Ios Island at the time the Meltemi winds start, and she is ready to enjoy watersports both above and below the surface. Andi will understand the significance this island has on its habitants when she discovers what is believed to be the tomb of Homer: the creator of the Iliad and the Odyssey. This is our final stop in this journey around the Cyclades, so Andi is ready to make the most of it.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 4
programme.desc: The February episode is Valentine’s Day themed! We meet the new members of SoftBank Team Japan and find out what it takes to make it onto the team, as well as their thoughts on love. Then, we get an exclusive look at the site of the AC35 Event Village, and take the ultimate challenge – trying out for Bermuda’s Red Bull Youth America’s Cup team.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4 - Zagreb
programme.desc: The capital of Croatia Zagreb is a not-to-miss destination, no matter if you arrive by boat, car or airplane. Only 1 hour from the coast it is definitely worth a visit. Most important attractions and some crazy museums will amaze you. There is also an interesting connection between Zagreb and nautics and we will reveal it all to you.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5 - Solta – Sibenik
programme.desc: The island of Solta is one of the most beautiful islands in the Central Dalmatia and we visited some very interesting places and coves. Sibenik is a city with many fortresses, old churches and UNESCO heritage. See it all in this episode.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Haiti
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Haiti while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Haiti: the Caribbean country that shares the island of Hispaniola with the Dominican Republic. Many of Haiti’s landmarks date to the early 19th century, and despite still recovering from the earthquake of 2010, Haiti is a beautiful paradise for many visitors.Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Haiti. Experience the Haitians history, art, culture, music, food, landscape, and their coastline as Sam leads you through what he calls, the off-beat track locations of the brilliant corners of the world.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

For more skilled canyoneers, it is the occasion to share their experience on a tricky terrain. However, all of them will have to cooperate and share a common desire: the thrill of unveiling the unknown in a trip that awakes fear and team spirit.Awards:Finalist – Everest International Film Festival 2020. Finalist – The Taste Awards 2020. Finalist Best Sport Film – Flicks Film Festival 2019. Best Short Documentary – Panama International Film Festival 2019, Maracay International Film Festival 2019, Short Film Factory 2019. Semi-Finalist – New Harvest Film Festival 2019. Int Film Festival, Mountain & Adventure Film Festival, Vertical Life Film Festival, Veracruz Short Film Festival, Montevideo Int Film Festival, Inca Int Film Festival, BangkokThai Int Film Festival etc.

programme.title: P1 USA AquaX - Episode 2 Cocoa Beach, FL
programme.desc: The AquaX competition continues its Round 2 on Cocoa Beach, Florida. Jet skies rush into the water at vertiginous speeds in the latest competition of the Championship. So far, challengers have only tested the water once, but they know the level is high and they will have to give their all in this competition in order to win. Find out what happens at Cocoa Beach.

programme.title: Up the Creek
programme.desc: There's only one boat race in the world where two-man teams blast up southern Australia's Murray River in aluminium dinghies at speeds of over 80kph. This river is not only known for dividing Victoria from New South Wales and for being Australia’s longest river, but also for being full of dangerous obstacles.Up the Creek challenges competing teams to speed up Murray River’s challenging water in a competition like no other. Find out now what will happen in this competition that explores Australia’s nature in depth, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 5 - GP of Sharjah
H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - GP of Italy (Runabout &Freestyle)
Jet Ski World Series - Round 2 - Poland
Reaching Reality - Episode 5 - Return
programme.desc: After nearly two months at sea, which now seems like lifetimes compounded by the suffering and challenge of the passage. The three are closing out their trip home and saving the best for last. Shocked by what seems to be death island, the three uncover shark hunters and in their last village before departure battle to resupply with the essentials of gas and water with the last pennies on the boat. Meanwhile the struggles of our filmmaker’s journey return along with the fear of going back to all that was left behind.

programme.title: Julbo Sail Session
programme.desc: The mythical, legendary Cape Horn towers high in the imagination of all sailors. Located in the southern part of the Patagonia, sailors will travel from Usuaïa to Cap Horn. Passing it is always a feat so you can imagine the adventure two men set out for themselves when they dreamed of being the ﬁrst to pass it in a Nacra.Aboard a flying catamaran, the Julbo Session is a unique event that requires constant attention. The situation at the Julbo Sail season is tense and things become serious as the sailors have to push forward whatever happens, as the weather window is very brief and they have little time to succeed in their adventure.Embark on this journey across la Tierra del Fuego, a mystical place with extraordinary landscapes and incredible shifts in weather that allowed sailors in the Nacra to achieve a lifetime dream: pass Cape Horn aboard a flying catamaran.

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

Wild Surf - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode, we’re in Nias, an idyllic island off the western coast of Sumatra in Indonesia. The island’s Lagundri Bay is world famous for its towering, lengthy barrels. We’re following the exploits of one Luke Dillon, an extremely promising, young, Cornish surfer, who made the trip with fellow Cornishman Jim Bergin, and photographer Paul Terry.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this episode, we’re starting off in Denmark with one of the hottest places to go surfing in the world right now, Klitmøller, aka Cold Hawaii. We’re keeping it chilly as we head to California for the Coldwater Classic. Then, the Surfing 4 Peace collective are bringing people together through this wonderful sport. Young filmmaker Jesper Jungell is then going to be introducing us to the breaks of California. Finally, we’re reporting on the monster El Niño swell that is currently hurtling towards Southern California.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of What SUP we meet David Brent and go paddleboarding for a chat on the water. He will talk about his experience on the stage before trying out the popular paddleboard yoga with Winny Clarke. We will hopefully learn how to relax on the water and not fall out of our boards too much!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
Of Men and Mavericks
programme.desc: After getting inspired by Chasing Mavericks, a movie featuring Gerard Butler, Of Men and Mavericks covers the story of surfing legends like Peter Mel, Jeff Clark and Mark Foo in their attempts to surf mavericks. They recount their first ventures in the Half Moon Bay spot and how they managed to conquer waves that reached more than 8 meters of height.Their perseverance, enthusiasm and willingness got them time after time into the cold waters of San Francisco to attempt a dangerous task that could have fatal repercussions. Their goal: to surf some of the biggest waves in the world.Follow the path of these brave surfers who leave it all behind to surf big waves, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Portofino Classic
programme.desc: The SIAD Bombola D’Oro Trophy is a regatta organized by the Italian Yacht Club, and a classic event in Italy’s sailing season. Situated in the picturesque bay of Portofino, this vintage regatta is a classic spectacle that drives the attention of people across Europe.The Bombola D’Oro partly connects its success to its boat class: the Dingy 12’. Designed in 1913, this class has maintained its appeal and tradition despite the assaults from extreme technical novelties. In The Portofino Classic, we will visit the port and experience this unique regatta to get a taste of the sailing culture in Italy.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this month’s episode, our first for 2020, we start our journey from the north Italy and Lake Garda where more than two hundred thirty athletes gathered for the 2019 RS:X Windsurfing World Championships. Then, staying in the Mediterranean Sea we’ll take you to the breathtaking Palma de Majorca following the fifth and final event of the 2019 44Cup.Later, we will leave Europe in order to move to Asia for one unique and epic event. The Belt and Road Sailing Regatta 2019 is the first month-long sailing event which connects China, Thailand, Singapore and Malaysia. We are here to capture all of the action. Staying in Asia we will travel to South Korea in order to witness all of the action from the prestigious Yisunsin Cup International Yacht Race 2019.Finally, we will take you back to Europe for one of the most stylish sailing events in Greece, the 10th Catamarans Cup.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 3 Itajai - HL
Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 4
programme.desc: Today the Clipper Race crews are going to face up their biggest challenge in this epic circumnavigation of the planet: the Mighty Pacific Ocean. Its fearsome reputation is well deserved and it is not clear how everyone will cope. We meet two novice Mexican sailors who join for the ride of their lives; and a sailor testing her nerve, as the teams are pushed to their limits, facing hurricane force winds, monstruous waves and relentless freezing temperatures.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of What SUP we meet David Brent and go paddleboarding for a chat on the water. He will talk about his experience on the stage before trying out the popular paddleboard yoga with Winny Clarke. We will hopefully learn how to relax on the water and not fall out of our boards too much!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
Reaching Reality - Episode 5 - Return
programme.desc: After nearly two months at sea, which now seems like lifetimes compounded by the suffering and challenge of the passage. The three are closing out their trip home and saving the best for last. Shocked by what seems to be death island, the three uncover shark hunters and in their last village before departure battle to resupply with the essentials of gas and water with the last pennies on the boat. Meanwhile the struggles of our filmmaker’s journey return along with the fear of going back to all that was left behind.

programme.title: Julbo Sail Session
programme.desc: The mythical, legendary Cape Horn towers high in the imagination of all sailors. Located in the southern part of the Patagonia, sailors will travel from Usuaïa to Cap Horn. Passing it is always a feat so you can imagine the adventure two men set out for themselves when they dreamed of being the ﬁrst to pass it in a Nacra.Aboard a flying catamaran, the Julbo Session is a unique event that requires constant attention. The situation at the Julbo Sail season is tense and things become serious as the sailors have to push forward whatever happens, as the weather window is very brief and they have little time to succeed in their adventure.Embark on this journey across la Tierra del Fuego, a mystical place with extraordinary landscapes and incredible shifts in weather that allowed sailors in the Nacra to achieve a lifetime dream: pass Cape Horn aboard a flying catamaran.

programme.title: H2O Racing: F1H2O World Championship - Episode 5 - GP of Sharjah

programme.desc: Ljubljana is the chosen scenery for the Slalom World Cup. programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
Wind Masters - Episode 9:NP Brijuni, Rovinj, Poreč, Vrsar, Novigrad
Rios Patagonicos
programme.desc: 15 canyoneers go on a life-changing expedition to discover the immensity of Chilean Patagonia in search for untouched territories, rivers and waterfalls organised by the Regard sur l’Aventure association. Their goal: to explore this mysterious land and spot and open over 30 canyons on a land where canyoneering is close to non-existent.For some, Rios Patagonicos is the opportunity to go on an expedition for the first time. For more skilled canyoneers, it is the occasion to share their experience on a tricky terrain. However, all of them will have to cooperate and share a common desire: the thrill of unveiling the unknown in a trip that awakes fear and team spirit.Awards:Finalist – Everest International Film Festival 2020. Finalist – The Taste Awards 2020. Finalist Best Sport Film – Flicks Film Festival 2019. Best Short Documentary – Panama International Film Festival 2019, Maracay International Film Festival 2019, Short Film Factory 2019. Semi-Finalist – New Harvest Film Festival 2019. Official Selections 2020: ATFF Costwolds, Trieste Int Mountain Film Festival, Naturetrack Film Festival, Mammoth Film Festival, Backpacklight Adventure Film Festival, Frozen River Film Festival, PIMFF etc. Official Selections 2019: Bansko, Explorimage, Festival du Film de Montagne, FICTS, Winter Film Festival, Rome Independent Prisma Awards, Sestriere Film Festival, Ember Aquatics Int Film Festival, Explos, Int Nature Film Festival Godollo, Les Escales Voyageuses, Rencontres du Film de Montagne, Adventure Shorts Film Festival, Big Water Film Festival, Action! Int Film Festival, Mountain & Adventure Film Festival, Vertical Life Film Festival, Veracruz Short Film Festival, Montevideo Int Film Festival, Inca Int Film Festival, BangkokThai Int Film Festival etc.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4 - Zagreb
programme.desc: The capital of Croatia Zagreb is a not-to-miss destination, no matter if you arrive by boat, car or airplane. Only 1 hour from the coast it is definitely worth a visit. Most important attractions and some crazy museums will amaze you. There is also an interesting connection between Zagreb and nautics and we will reveal it all to you.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5 - Solta – Sibenik
programme.desc: The island of Solta is one of the most beautiful islands in the Central Dalmatia and we visited some very interesting places and coves. Sibenik is a city with many fortresses, old churches and UNESCO heritage. See it all in this episode.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 3 Itajai - HL
Wind Masters - Episode 10: Baranja, PP Kopački rit, Osijek, Aljmaš, Vukovar, Slavonski Brod, Ilok.
Shifting Ice + Changing Tides
programme.desc: In March 2014 six women set sail from Iceland with the intention of sailing across the Denmark Strait and up the west coast of Greenland. Shifting Ice and Changing Tides' is a unique human and wind powered, female led, ski and sail expedition that is captivating for the beauty of its white, gelid landscape.In this remote, fascinating and beautiful region, six women will explore and ski first descents while limiting their environmental footprint by sailing and climbing. The expedition will serve as a platform for raising awareness about climate change and environmental issues as well as for inspiring and promoting female participation in snow sports adventures.Join them as they adventure in the wilderness to collect scientific data in one of the most incredible and deathly climates. This is their story.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 4
programme.desc: In today's episode of Screen Heroes we land in France. Before we check out the 10th edition of the International Surf Film Festival in Anglet we will be taking a closer look at this beautiful region. In the first win of the festival, Garrett Mcnamara's search for the world's biggest wave in Nazare has left us mesmerized. Will the rest of the movies cause the same impact?

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 4
programme.desc: Andi is back in the Watamu Marine Reserve but this time on a new mission: save the endangered sea turtles. She spends three days at the Local Ocean Trust with Marine Biologist Casper van de Geer. If Andi can learn the importance of sea turtles in the marine ecosystem and the vital skills needed to protect them, she might have the opportunity to release a turtle back into the wild.

programme.title: PRADA 36th America's Cup - The Last Call Documentary
programme.desc: The competition in the PRADA 36th America’s Cup has come to an end, but we cannot leave without a tribute. In The Last Call Documentary, we go back in time to see the best moments and talk with the characters that define the present and future of the America's Cup. From the preparation for the PRADA Cup to the result in the 36th America's Cup Match find it all out.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 4
programme.desc: This time on Jump on Board, Cindy, Caitlin and Linda sail from Lefkada to Ithaca, home of Ulysses. The girls will discover the islands beauty, unspoiled by the modern world and the place where Penelope had the difficult task of fending off her suitors, alone, without her husband's help. Who will lose the challenge and be the next Penelope between our girls?

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl - Naxos Part 1
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl has just arrived to the island of Naxos for the start of summer and the windy season. Naxos is a gem in the Aegean sea, where laughter, activity , sprwaling nature and beautiful beaches await. She is determined to explore the diversity of the island, from ancient greek ruins to modern watersports. Will she be able to handle the strong winds or will rough seas get the better of her?

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 5
programme.desc: In this episode of Road to Bermuda, we celebrate International Woman’s Day by uncovering some of the most inspirational and influential ladies in sailing to date. We have plenty of action from the M32 series, and we watch as some of our favourite AC sailors are taken hostage by the pirates of Bermuda, on board the Spirit of Bermuda. Also, we'll be following the Endeavour Programme to leave the sporting legacy in Bermuda and the island's status as the Shipwreck Capital of the World.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 6 - Sibenik Islands - Murter
programme.desc: There are several interesting islands in the Sibenik area and we visited some of them. The island of Murter is known for its famous figs and delicacies from this healthy fruit. We will also show you some interesting places for swimming and sailing.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 7 - Kornati – Dugi Otok
programme.desc: Kornati Islands are a National park and one of the most amazing creation of nature (or God) and sailing here is a real rest for heart and soul. Dugi Otok with its natural beauty, interesting places and amazing gastronomy is a real paradise for sailors.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Jamaica
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Jamaica while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Jamaica: the third-largest island of the Greater Antilles and Caribbean, home to famous personalities like Bob Marley or Usain Bolt. Through extreme surf travel and consequent writing and aestheticized by jazz, Sam Bleakley gives a voice to the brilliant corners of this country, revealing the character of the place by getting inside the mind of a coastline as much as people.Immerse yourself in the beauty of the yet to discover areas of the Caribbean, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: Since 1977, the Cannes Yachting Festival takes place every September in elegant, luxurious surroundings in the sparkling bay of Cannes. We are ready for the 2018 edition that promises the latest trends in the nautical industry. Jump on board the 2018 Cannes Yachting Festival to discover superyachts, equipment, regattas, competitions and more.

programme.title: Yoga Is Healing
programme.desc: Today's practice is an exploration of healing, the deep inner work that yoga opens you up to. Begin with a seated practice for checking in with breath and body, cultivating an attitude of complete acceptance. This class offers up a standing forward fold, Padangusthasana, as a vehicle for understanding what yoga is. Kino will teach you the important details of alignment while keeping a focus on not pushing too hard and instead releasing and trusting the process.

programme.title: Facing Injury in the Practice
programme.desc: When it comes to yoga practice, there's nothing more difficult that facing an injury.

programme.title: Yoga Is Awakening
programme.desc: Yoga is a path to personal awakening. In today’s lesson we will use the crescent lunge to awaken the energy at the core of your being. Begin with centering breath work and then flow through some warm ups and sun salutations as you bring awareness to the energetic life of the body. Take it nice and easy as you make your way into Anjaneyasana, finding and being at peace with your individual limits in the posture. Kino will guide you into feeling the sensation in the hips and spine, noticing the changes in the body and and letting the practice fuel a sense of awakening.

programme.title: Healing through Yoga, from Body Image and Abuse to Peace and Love with Jessica Sayre
programme.desc: Join Kino and Jessica for a fully loaded conversation that touches on various topics.

programme.title: Meet Alexa
programme.desc: Alexa Soto turned her passion for cooking into a way of life.

programme.title: Crispy Orange Cauliﬂower “Chicken”
programme.desc: It’s a spin on Orange Chicken – learn how to make this delicious, crispy orange cauliflower with Alexa Soto.

programme.title: Sun Salutations
programme.desc: Join Mark for a class that investigates the main movement positions in the traditional Sun Salutations.

programme.title: Shoulders
programme.desc: Build power and foundation with Kino as you join her for more Yoga Drills. This is perfect for those who are looking to build strength and learn strength building techniques. It's a great practice for those who are interested in becoming stronger both inside and out. Get ready to sweat and have some fun!

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for one of her favorite daily yoga drills, plank! Kino takes you through a quick warm up before diving into the challenging world of plank pose. Get ready to tone your core and strengthen your shoulders!

programme.title: Yin Yoga for Deep Relaxation and Healing - Open Heart - Calm Your Nerves
programme.desc: Perfect for all levels. Tune in here when you’re wanting to relax and wind down. Originally streamed live on March 26, 2020.

programme.title: Prasarita Padottanasana
programme.desc: A relaxing practice that utilizes props to both get you stronger and allow you to relax more. This class flows through standing poses and focuses on the forward fold called Prasarita Padottanasana.

programme.title: Side Plank
programme.desc: Begin this gentle flow with a few moments of mindfulness, then explore the basics of yoga as we build up to a supported practice of side plank

programme.title: Leaning into Forward Folds
programme.desc: This session is all about sitting with the hamstrings and forward bends in a state of equanimity. Join Kino as she leads you on a journey to healing. Learn to sit with your discomfort and begin to uncover and understand the intelligent messages that come from within. 25 minutes

programme.title: Emotions
programme.desc: Welcome to Meditations for Manifesting, how to bring yourself back into alignment with the greater good and pray from a place of wholeness and true faith. Episode one is all about the emotions. Begin with breath awareness, establishing a calm and steady mind. Cultivate a judgment free attitude as you explore the inner world of your thoughts and feelings.

programme.title: Yoga Nidra for Chakra Balancing
programme.desc: Join Irene for a yoga nidra that’s designed to promote Chakra balancing.

programme.title: Breathwork
programme.desc: Use this practice to work with improving your 3-dimensional breathing.

programme.title: Standing Postures
programme.desc: Follow Mark as he walks your through techniques that will help you improve your function in standing poses.

programme.title: Yoga Is Commitment
programme.desc: This class centers around commitment, so Kino is asking you start by going all in. The intention here is to get you on your mat every day, even if you don’t make it through the whole class, so that you can cultivate greater awareness of your body and mind. In this class we’ll build up to a steady, well constructed Down Dog by focusing on the shoulders in a series of preparatory postures. Flow through child's pose, table top, puppy pose and sun salutations as you create healthy patterns of movement and breath control. The commitment you make to the practice is really a statement of your self worth. Join Kino on the mat and say: I am worth it! I am worth these few moments of precious practice.

programme.title: Seated Position for Meditation
programme.desc: Find the meditation position, (legs crossed, seated in a chair or laying down) that is accessible for you.

programme.title: BBQ Cauliﬂower Ranch Salad
programme.desc: This super simple salad is easy to make and perfect to take with you on the go.

programme.title: Boredom in Yoga
programme.desc: Join kino for a conversation about boredom in the yoga practice, what it means, and what you can do about it.

programme.title: Struggling with Neck Pain
programme.desc: Today, Kino answers a student question about how to deal with neck pain in your yoga practice.

programme.title: Facing Injury in the Practice
programme.desc: When it comes to yoga practice, there's nothing more difficult that facing an injury.

programme.title: Yoga for Inflexible People - Light the Fire – Downward Dog
programme.desc: If you're feeling not so flexible, this course is where you should be! This class is focused on understanding shoulder mobility in the fundamental yoga asana called downdog,

programme.title: Eat Like a Yogi - Ayurvedic Potion Apoptogenic Golden Mylk
programme.desc: Golden milk is a turmeric based Ayurvedic potion that has numerous benefits for both your mind and your body. Enjoy this tea any time of day and start to notice the difference in how you feel. Less than 10 minutes.

programme.title: Meet Alexa
programme.desc: Alexa Soto turned her passion for cooking into a way of life.

programme.title: Garlic Hummus Mushroom Toast

programme.title: Creamy Butternut Squash Tomato Soup with Grilled "Cheese"

programme.title: Kino in San Francisco
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Global Yogi, Kino climbs the hills of San Fran! Join her as she explores this great town, one of the oldest cities on the United States west coast. Tag along as we venture through the famous micro climates of the city. Cross the Golden Gate Bridge, learn about escapes from Alcatraz, see the Gardens of Lombard Street and so much more! After all those handstands and asanas in front of scenic views, we stop for some of local food and to enjoy the local color. Kino's signature sense of humor and storytelling take center stage in this episode, as she delights in sharing San Francisco with you!

programme.title: How to Become a Rich Yogi - True wealth story
programme.desc: In this last video, Rob shares a story that will help remind you of everything you’ve learned through this course. This story offers up one more practice that you can apply to your life to truly become a rich yogi.

programme.title: Plank
programme.desc: Join Kino for one of her favorite daily yoga drills, plank! Kino takes you through a quick warm up before diving into the challenging world of plank pose. Get ready to tone your core and strengthen your shoulders!

programme.title: Reclined Twist
programme.desc: A relaxing practice that incorporates the fundamentals of yoga and has a focus on reclining twists.

programme.title: Kino in Bali
programme.desc: Come with Kino as she explores magical Bali in the latest installment of Global Yogi. This place is a mecca for yoga, healing, surfing and is known for its welcoming and peaceful Balinese culture. Here it’s common to discover a feeling of being safe and sound, and that was certainly the case for Kino. Green juice, island sand, coconuts and temples… the intoxicating energy of the island spirit can be found around every corner. Days are easily spent relaxing and and enjoying waves and sunsets. Check in for a massage, roll out your mat for practice, chat with the charming locals and find the perfect spot for a quiet meditation… All this and more as Kino continues to bring her message of insight and transformation to the world.

programme.title: Tree Pose

Begin practice with a reflection on the connection between breath, body and mind. Next, move through a series of long holds in child’s pose, puppy poses and forward folding. Take a supported hip opener using props if you have them handy and then move into another long hold, this time in Pigeon Pose. Take note of any sensations and feelings that arise, offering yourself true care and opening up to a sense of wholeness.

The idea is to work outside of your comfort zone, just a little, so you seek a source of strength from deep within. As you embrace the challenge you can also embrace a sense of sanctuary and connect to an inner space of faith and grace.

programme.desc: Open your heart to an experience of pure joy. We’ll use Happy Baby pose to explore what yoga truly is. Flow through child’s pose, puppy pose, squats and hip openers before making your way into the sweet release of Happy Baby. No judgement, no fight, no force… use this practice to touch the unscathed, joyful innocence within you.

programme.title: Everyday Drill
programme.desc: When it comes to building strength and flexibility for a more well-rounded yoga practice, yoga drills can help you expedite the process! Join Kino for a set of yoga drills that offer a little mix of everything. Stretch out and strengthen the core, legs, arms, shoulders, and everything in between. Just over 20 minutes.

programme.title: Healing and Happiness
programme.desc: Begin practice with a few minutes of mindfulness, feeling the breath and sensation in the body as a way of cultivating inward focus. Shift into a contemplative state, settling the mind below the frequency of thought. Learn to label inner processes in a way that will help you understand the nature of thought and emotion. As the quality of your awareness shifts deeper, Kino will skillfully guide you into a state of contemplation. This practice will help you process emotion and move towards healing and happiness.

programme.title: Yoga Inspiration Podcast - A conversation about communication
programme.desc: Kino sits down to talk with mediator and coach Mia Forbes Pirie. Mia discusses her approach to mediation and gives advice about how to use curiosity to navigate interpersonal conflict. Explore techniques to help you approach life with patience and compassion of yourself and others.

programme.title: How to Become a Rich Yogi - How to quiet our mind
programme.desc: True peace is something that exists inside of you at all times, but the only way to access this peace is by learning to quiet the mind. So how do you do it? Watch the video to find out!

programme.title: Parsvottanasana
programme.desc: This 20 minute practice starts with the basics, building a connection to breath and body. Flow through standing poses that build up to a prop supported variation of Parsvottanasana.

programme.title: Bridge
programme.desc: This practice takes you on a journey through the fundamentals of yoga and culminates in a gentle backbend, the bridge pose

programme.title: Backbend - Listen
programme.desc: Join Kino for as class that’s all about backbends and the journey of listening. Begin to tap into the subtle body as you move through this mindful, 25-minute backbending practice. Talk to your muscles and joints and listen to them as you find the strength and flexibility to move through this practice, all while bringing your awareness to various places in the body.

programme.title: Yoga Is Commitment
programme.desc: This class centers around commitment, so Kino is asking you start by going all in. The intention here is to get you on your mat every day, even if you don’t make it through the whole class, so that you can cultivate greater awareness of your body and mind. In this class we’ll build up to a steady, well constructed Down Dog by focusing on the shoulders in a series of preparatory postures. Flow through child's pose, table top, puppy pose and sun salutations as you create healthy patterns of movement and breath control. The commitment you make to the practice is really a statement of your self worth. Join Kino on the mat and say: I am worth it! I am worth these few moments of precious practice.

programme.title: Meditation Now - Release Judgment
programme.desc: Join Kino for a seaside meditation along the shores of the beautiful, Tulum, Mexico. Quite the mind and release all judgement so you can rest in the blissful awareness of all that is.

programme.title: Meditation Now - The Breath
programme.desc: Join Kino for a gentle meditation on the beach by the beautiful shores of Tulum, Mexico. Let go of your thoughts, and experiences as you use the breath to anchor you to the present moment.

programme.title: Morning Routine
programme.desc: One of Mark’s favorite morning routines, this is a slow-moving practice featuring static holds.

programme.title: Yoga Is Kindness
programme.desc: Invite kindness into your body, using Marichasana A as a framework for integrating tenderness into your practice. Let Kino guide you through a series of mindful, preparatory postures that bring awareness into the legs, hips and shoulders. This increased awareness will aid you as you move into the forward fold that today's practice revolves around. Use props where needed so that you can cultivate a kind and friendly attitude towards your body.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: The Road Ahead
programme.desc: Fredrik Erixon, a passionate adventurer crosses Sweden on roller skis from the north in Karesuando in Lappland, to Smygehuk in Skane in the south – a solo journey of about 2000 km over thirty days - representing one Vasaloppet a day (most famous cross country ski race). He rolls across the Arctic Polar Circle, meets interesting people and examines his own motivation in challenging himself and pushing his comfort zone.

programme.title: The First Second - Michi Wohlleben
programme.desc: «The higher you raise the bar the further you fall down!”. Michi language is made of very strong, singular sentences, as sharpened as his climbing style. His sentences try to define himself, without worrying about himself, by thwarting clichés… but do not succeed in really finding himself. On the other hand his words create beautiful images that show Michis inspiration, fluidity, and pleasure in action. Through the discovery of his goals and his gamble with the risk, Michi mixes both quest and primal pleasure.

programme.title: UIPM 2025 Obstacle World Championships
programme.desc: Beijing’s Olympic Centre turns into a proving ground as the UIPM Obstacle World Championships crown new stars across the 400 m, 3 K, and blistering 100 m sprint.

programme.title: Santos Tour Down Under Women 2026
programme.desc: 9th edition of the Womens Tour Down Under, which is the part of the 2026 UCI Womens World Tour.

programme.title: Cape To Cape 2025 Eng
programme.desc: 800 riders have assembled for the 17th edition of the Australian Cape To Cape mountain bike stage race. Starting at Cape Leeuwin lighthouse and finishing four days later up at Cape Naturaliste, the course makes its way through a network of trails along the coast, through National Parks, forest, farm lands, mountain bike parks, and bush before heading up to the northern cape of the South West WA region. Roughly 200km and 2,500m of climbing in total, each day’s riding is between 34km and 59km and has its own special terrain and environment to keep things interesting with a mix of fast flowing single trail, farm tracks, groomed downhill trails and fire trails.

programme.title: Tour de la Provence 2026 Eng
programme.desc: Since its creation in 2016, the CIC Tour de La Provence has established itself as a key stage on the cycling calendar, offering top riders ideal training grounds for the Tour de France. Between demanding climbs and iconic landscapes, the race tests punchers, climbers, and sprinters, attracting a high-level field each year. More than just a competition, it embodies the popular spirit of cycling and benefits from the support of a passionate region, making each edition an unmissable event of the season.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: Mediterranean Epic 2026 Eng
programme.desc: The Mediterranean Epic offers an UCI 4 stage race where mountain bikers enjoy mountain biking to the fullest during the route around Oropesa del Mar, in the Castellón province in Spain. From 05th to 08th of February 2026 the race leads through spectacular Mediterranean mild weather and routes with a perfect combination of sea and mountain!

programme.title: Alula Tour 2026 Eng
programme.desc: This five-day spin around the Saudi Arabian city has become a popular choice for many teams as they embark on the new cycling season. 116 riders from 17 squads are participating this year.

programme.title: Nedbank Gravel Burn 2025
programme.desc: Nedbank Gravel Burn is a 7-day, 800km full-service gravel stage race through South Africa’s diverse landscapes. Starting in coastal forests, the route heads into the breathtaking Great Karoo – a vast, spectacular semi-desert region. Riders rest each night in remote ‘Burn Camps’ under star-filled skies and, on the final day, greeted by Africa’s iconic Big 5 wildlife.

programme.title: GKA Freestyle World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: The First Second - Geraldine Fasnacht
programme.desc: When Geraldine, the bird woman puts on her mask, we know that the images of the pink wingsuit will be closer to poetry than adrenaline! Several snowboard world championship titles, more than 3200 jumps, but at the start, how do you decide to ride and fly all your life?

programme.title: One Water Race 2025 - The Film Eng
programme.desc: One Water Race is an endurance race based on Running, Swimming and Orienteering. 10 mixed teams of 4 athletes have to cross the Stockholm-Sweden archipelago from North to South in a non-stop 250 km race with 200 km of running and 50 km of swimming. They have to completely handle their navigation including in the darkness.

programme.title: The First Second - Samantha Davies
programme.desc: Samantha Davies sees the ocean as a pleasure, obvious. In symbiosis with her boat, she leads a violent struggle with the harsh conditions and "loves it" in an almost inexplicable way! She knows and enjoys her luck, which she shares with Initiatives Cœur. She also measures it to that of her grandfather, a war submariner…. At the start of a race like the Vendée Globe, it is an adventurer who sets off.

programme.title: SFT Wake Foil E-Foil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates, will make history this autumn as it hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.

programme.title: Moana Waiwai - The Film
programme.desc: Moana Waiwai or The Great Ocean in Maori, is about the FreeSwim journey of wahine (woman) Ally Davey as she swims 70km of open ocean around the stunning Coromandel coastline over three days to raise awareness for the protection of New Zealands oceans. It does more than encapsulate stunning vistas and highlight the extraordinary New Zealand environment. It inspires people to be aware of the natural beauty that surrounds them.

programme.title: 2025 ROLEX New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup
programme.desc: Twenty teams from 12 countries would compete in the ninth Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup, the biennial regatta hosted by the New York Yacht Club Harbour Court in Newport, R.I. Since the event was first run in 2009, it has attracted top amateur sailors from 51 of the world’s most prestigious yacht clubs from 23 countries.

programme.title: GKA Hydrofoil Big Air World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi will host the GKA Kite World Tour for the first time, bringing back-to-back World Cups in Hydrofoil Big Air and Freestyle to Fahid Island, Abu Dhabi’s newest coastal wellness destination and the world’s first Fitwel-certified island, offering 11kms of coastline.

programme.title: Nastro Rosa Tour 2025 Eng
programme.desc: The Marina Militare Nastro Rosa Tour returns in 2025 for its fifth edition, offering a unique journey that blends high-level competition with Italy’s maritime culture and coastal beauty. Since its debut in 2021, the Tour has grown into more than a sailing event—it has become a travelling festival of the sea, connecting athletes, coastal cities, and local communities in a shared celebration of sport, heritage, and discovery.

programme.title: The First Second - Armel Le Cl ac h E
programme.desc: Armel Le Cléach creates his victories thanks to a strong relationship with the whole team of which he is the extension ... But for this navigator engaged in a daunting battle with the ocean on a giant 32-meter trimaran, each course towards a new start is a new battle with the unknown, with his own will and with his primary adversary: himself.

programme.title: GWA Wingfoil World Cup Abu Dhabi 2025
programme.desc: Abu Dhabi, the capital of the United Arab Emirates hosts the GWA Wingfoil World Cup for the first time, marking the grand finale of the 2025 FreeFly-Slalom season. Leading the charge are two-time defending world champions, Nia Suardiaz, of Spain, and Francesco Cappuzzo, of Italy, who head to Abu Dhabi leading the rankings. With the season’s final stop still wide open, both athletes will need flawless performances to secure their third consecutive titles.
